title: Battery Capacity Estimator (Kalman Filter)
text: Battery capacity estimator with Kalman filter, 3 inputs, 1 output, {Filter type} sets Kalman; {Specify Current input as cell current(s)} sets the option to specify current input port, {Alpha}, {Beta}, {Kappa}, {Covariance of the process noise, Q} sets the covariance of process, {Covariance of the measurement noise, R} sets the covariance of measurement, {Initial state error covariance, P0} sets the initial state error, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the block sample time and {Algorithm data type} sets the option to choose data type for block algorithm. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: CellSOC
ports.summary: Cell state of charge, unitless scalar | vector

ports.name: InitialCellAH
ports.summary: Initial cell capacity, A*Hr scalar | vector

params.name: Specify Current input as cell current(s)
params.values: Option to specify current input port as vector off (default) | on

params.name: Filter type
params.values: Kalman filter type Extended Kalman filter (default) | Extended Kalman-Bucy filter | Unscented Kalman filter | Unscented Kalman-Bucy filter

params.name: Alpha
params.values: Alpha coefficient 1 (default) | scalar in the range [0, 1]

params.name: Kappa
params.values: Kappa coefficient 0 (default) | scalar in the range [0, 3]

params.name: Covariance of the process noise, Q
Covariance of the measurement noise, R
Initial state error covariance, P0
params.values: Initial state error covariance 1e-8 (default) | scalar | matrix

params.name: Algorithm data type
params.values: Option to choose data type for block algorithm Inherit: auto (default) | double | single |
